about: G291/G294/G306 report-only: authored shard runtime TS plus raw GLSL (including shader literals in data/generators) and singly-reached platform source divided by the registered frozen legacy TS size; PASS <=20 %. Tests and generated/baked output never count. Runtime TS excludes generators/data; raw shaders are custom in every folder. A module is public only when reached by >=2 primary shards or _template (frozen copies excluded). Source/runtime TS and additional GLSL are charged once. G304 built-content counts and private binary paths are reported separately; trusted simulation remains transitional even with passing witnesses. Historical baseline/ceilings below keep their old enforcement; the new report adds no failure.
